responsibility: Renders region inference constraint graphs as Graphviz output, both at the raw region-constraint level and at the SCC-compressed level, for debugging NLL inference structure.
same_name_distinction: This `graphviz.rs` renders NLL region constraint graphs and their SCC-compressed form for debugging region inference. The other Graphviz files target different domains: solved dataflow state over CFGs, or whole MIR-body graph rendering utilities.
